summary: Committed the Unity/Git/Svelte/Activity extensions to the gizmo-registry repo, then refactored the Git server extension to expose a new 'commit-context' operation and updated the agent-server websocket dispatcher to call generateCommitMessage from it. Inlined a local patchFileName helper in ToolResult.svelte, removed the @gizmo/unity test setup, and pruned the @gizmo/{activity,git,svelte,unity,unity-tools,skill-authoring} dependencies from @gizmo/app and @gizmo/agent-server.
decisions: Added a 'commit-context' case to the Git extension descriptor that delegates to a new service.commitContext(workspacePath) so commit-message generation is decoupled from the commit operation.
Refactored websocket-server.ts to import GitService as a value and reuse the shared instance instead of constructing one per connection.
Inlined the patchFileName helper directly in ToolResult.svelte rather than importing it from @gizmo/git/web.
Removed the Unity web extension from apps/app/src/test/setup.ts, replacing it with registerWebExtensions([]) in afterEach.
Stripped the 'extensions:build' script and the unity prebuild guard from the root package.json dev script.
